notes.title: I just launched a Kickstarter and I need your help!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45227549/8f303db3ca6a04dcd73f852193a615e888eac35f.png[/img]

Hi, I just launched a Kickstarter campaign to fund my game Galen's Eye, dedicate more time to my YouTube channel, and help you with your projects. With that support, I could finally stop working as a freelancer and dedicate myself 100% to this. Thank you always for your support. 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dpgamedevelopment/galens-eye?ref=project_build
